name: Danijela
headline: Turn Deutsche Telekom’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells tariffs for private customers, home internet and fibre, and a route into the online shop, and every visitor sees the same message whether they came for a new contract or a business offer.

Once a customer is in the Telekom Kundencenter, what they use, which tariff they carry and which services they never touch is your strongest signal for the next upgrade or cancellation. Today it sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns for a tariff with home internet and fibre are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Early churn signals per customer from tariff use, service changes and contact history. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right upgrade when it fits
cases.text: Next best tariff or add-on per customer, triggered by what they actually use. No more blanket upgrade mails to customers who already have the right contract.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer using the services
cases.text: Personal nudges to use the services they already pay for, by email and in the Telekom Kundencenter, so every customer has a reason to engage again this week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
